coverage.note: 1980-01-02 to 1980-08-20. 24 meetings read (20 regular and 4 special: site inspections on June 9, 1980 for Appeals 8895 and 8899, and on June 17, 1980 for Appeals 8894 and 8905, each printed as a special-meeting block). The May 14, 1980 meeting's body text reads May 28, 1980 while its heading and page footers say May 14; it is recorded as May 14. Appeal numbers in this volume are four-digit (e.g. 8772), with a V- prefix for variance appeals; the 1981 volume uses a different numbering sequence. Conflicts recorded as printed: two different appeals are both numbered 8834 (April 16 second-hand dealer permit at 1494 California Street; April 23 alteration permit at 1072 Bryant Street) and two different appeals are both numbered 8831 in the April 9 minutes (606 Geary Street and 2201 Chestnut); Appeal 8818 is printed at 4062 18th Street on March 19 and 4052 18th Street on May 28; Appeal 8895 is printed at 1774 23rd Avenue on June 4 and 1774 23rd Street on June 11; the June 11 rehearing item for 660 Third Street is printed under appeal number 8883 and is recorded as 8893; the July 23 vote on Appeal 8848 is printed as 4 to 0 to overrule with one commissioner voting to uphold and is read as 4-1; jurisdiction for the 2144 Beach Street protest was denied May 14, 1980 and granted May 28, 1980. The February 27, 1980 meeting is missing from the scan, so Appeals 8803 (224 Douglass Street) and 8792 never reach a decision in this volume. Open threads beyond this volume: Appeal 8948 (172 Raymond Street) continued to September 3, 1980; Appeal V8951 (4521 17th Street) continued to October 8, 1980; the rehearing of Appeal 8894 (4230 18th Street) granted August 6, 1980 with no date set; the Appeal 8784 (21 Alta Street) stipulation-compliance matter calendared as a special item on August 20, 1980. A fifth commissioner joined the board by the April 9, 1980 meeting, filling the vacancy noted on February 13, 1980. Executive Director Philip J. Siggins resigned effective July 1, 1980 and was succeeded by Claire C. Pilcher.
